said.text: Create/edit/manage/orchestrate agents with skills, personas, lingo, tools and per-agent persistent memory. Wizards: new agent, new skill, new tool, all-in-one agent builder, auto-training (Firecrawl, MCP tools, other sources). Add-on agents install as bundles; 3 add-ons: React/TS/Python coder, AmberX AXF framework expert, AI capabilities expert. The Opus version is in apps/console-web/plugins/agent-manager (web console only): remove it first with its uninstall script, then build this one following plugin-lifecycle@1, and port to Android + other ports.
